definitions.explanation: A powerful wind that can cause disruption or damage. Commonly used in weather reports and news.

examples.japanese: {強風|きょうふう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧。
examples.english: My umbrella broke in the strong wind.

examples.japanese: {強風|きょうふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{運休|うんきゅう}→運休：06807_unkyuu⟧になった。
examples.english: Trains were suspended due to strong winds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{強風|きょうふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}き{荒|あ}れ→吹き荒れる：08316_fukiareru⟧、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Strong winds raged due to the typhoon, causing damage in various areas.

notes:
USAGE:
{強風|きょうふう} is a compound of {強|きょう} (strong) and {風|ふう} (wind). It is frequently used in weather forecasts and transportation announcements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {強風|きょうふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ (strong winds blow)
- {強風|きょうふう}{注意報|ちゅういほう} (strong wind advisory)
- {強風|きょうふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧ (due to strong winds)
- {強風|きょうふう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{煽|あお}られる→煽る：07924_aoru⟧ (to be buffeted by strong winds)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {強風|きょうふう}: strong wind (neutral, weather term)
- ⟦{暴風|ぼうふう}→暴風：07951_boufuu⟧: violent wind, storm-force wind (more extreme)
- ⟦{突風|とっぷう}→突風：15921_toppuu⟧: gust of wind (sudden, brief)
- ⟦{微風|びふう}→微風：21286_bifuu⟧: gentle breeze (opposite end of scale)
